concerns.text: Task T013 (fetch 50 literature PCMs) is marked 'FAILED: unspecified' and 'UNRESOLVED-CLAIM'. It is a hard prerequisite for T023 (External Validation) and T024 (Sensitivity Analysis). No task exists to resolve the data fetch failure or implement a fallback strategy (e.g., using a different DOI or reducing the set size) to unblock US3. The spec (US3) and plan (Phase 2) require this external validation set; without a working task to produce it, FR-005 and SC-003 cannot be satisfied.

Task T023 (External Validation) depends on T013. Since T013 is broken and no recovery task exists, T023 cannot be executed. The spec (FR-005) requires validating derived rules against an independent set of known PCMs. The current task list provides no path to generate this input, leaving FR-005 and SC-003 uncovered by executable work.

Task T024 (Sensitivity Analysis) lists T013 as a prerequisite. With T013 failing, T024 is blocked. The spec (FR-004) mandates a sensitivity analysis on thresholds using the external validation set. No alternative task or fallback mechanism is defined to perform this analysis if the primary data fetch fails, leaving FR-004 and SC-004 uncovered.
